svg.title: JE2 experimental design
svg.desc: PAO1 spent medium is sterile-filtered before JE2 exposure. Nine genotype-by-condition groups each have three biological samples. Pulse is15minutes; long exposure isapproximately15hours.
svg.text: Growth in TSB, then 15 min PASN
3 genotypes x 3 conditions x 3 biological replicates = 27 samples
